answer: Neighborhood anchor routing.** Each identity must be reachable through at least two independent relay paths whose endpoints already transact with it, forming a stable local cluster—an oasis of verified edges. Isolated newcomers sit in an open ocean of unconnected addresses until they establish real trade links. Every new identity must seed an anchor edge by paying a routing deposit held until that edge carries sustained traffic. Cloning forces the attacker to fund distinct relay neighborhoods per clone, multiplying infrastructure cost linearly.
